standard_prerequisites.name: Independence of the choice of covering
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the pullback of a section to be computed with a convenient covering.

core_obligations: Local description (proof lines 2173-2180): a section of the plus construction over an object arises from a compatible family over a covering; refining the covering and computing the pullback with the refined covering exhibits the restriction of the section as the image under the canonical map of one of the members of the family.
proof_roadmap: Choose a covering presenting the given section.
Refine it so that the pullback can be computed with it.
Identify the restriction as the image of a member of the compatible family.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that every section of the plus construction becomes, after restricting to a covering, the image of a section of the original presheaf under the canonical map (statement lines 2163-2170). The proof is a short but complete argument: the given section is presented by a compatible family over a covering, and after refining the covering the author computes the pullback of the section with the refined covering and identifies it with the image of a member of the family (proof lines 2173-2180). The non-formal content is the identification of the restriction with the image of a member. The claim is H1: a one-step argument with its input named.
